clips.title: The story
paras: Handfuls of Stardust are shimmering, frosted coatings gathered from sparkling bushes in the southern wilderness of Ashenvale. Sourced from the ancient Ruins of Stardust, this powder possesses cooling natural properties prized by night elven healers treating intense fevers.

Found clinging to the leafy shrubs within the ancient Ruins of Stardust south of Astranaar, stardust appears as a fine, luminous frost. While the ruins themselves are haunted by lingering elemental spirits, the vegetation that thrives among the broken stones absorbs a rare ambient luminescence. Traditional night elven medicine makes use of this frosted residue, processing it into poultices to draw out persistent, dangerous fevers when ordinary salves and moonwell waters fail to bring complete relief.
